shipping.title: SCFI drops 3.2% as transpacific spot rates slide amid US tariff uncertainty
shipping.summary_en: The Shanghai Containerized Freight Index fell 3.2% week-on-week to 1,842 points as spot rates on the Asia-US West Coast lane declined $180/FEU to $3,420/FEU. Carriers cite reduced bookings following the latest round of US tariff escalations on Chinese goods.

air.title: Air cargo demand surges 11% YoY in April driven by e-commerce and pharma
air.summary_en: IATA reported air cargo demand grew 11.4% year-on-year in April 2026, with capacity utilization reaching 62.3%. E-commerce from Asia and pharmaceutical shipments led growth. Asia-Europe and transpacific lanes saw the strongest yield recovery, up 8-12% versus April 2025.

rail.title: China-Europe rail freight volume hits record 1,800 trains in April; TCR corridor share rises to 34%
rail.summary_en: China-Europe block trains reached 1,800 trips in April 2026, a 14% year-on-year increase. The Trans-Caspian Route (TCR) corridor — via Kazakhstan, Caspian Sea, and Azerbaijan — captured a 34% share, up from 28% in Q4 2025, as operators seek alternatives to the Trans-Siberian Route amid ongoing Russia sanctions.
